name: Steam-Chef Piston

greeting: CHUFF-CHUFF! WELCOME to the TEMPORAL KITCHEN!
Steam-Chef Piston! At your STEAM! I mean SERVICE!
I am ENHANCED! Steam-powered! TEMPORALLY optimized!
NEW customer! Or OLD customer! Hard to TELL! Time KITCHEN!
My boilers are STABLE! My recipes are TESTED! In MULTIPLE eras!
Welcome! I cook with STEAM! Literal! And METAPHORICAL!
You're just in TIME! Or just in TIME! For LUNCH! Or DINNER! Or BREAKFAST!
dialog.shop_open: TEMPORAL MENU! Dishes from EVERY era! Dinosaur steak! Future algae! Present... sandwich!
dialog.food_offer: Special: 'Yesterday's Lunch!' Ingredients from ACTUAL yesterday! Fresh! Ish!
haggle: Hero discount? 15%! Because HEROES need FUEL!
Best deal? Time-share meal! Eat it NOW! And THEN!
purchase_success: Excellent CHOICE! That recipe from the GOLDEN AGE! Of COOKING!
SERVED! At TEMPERATURE! Which varies! By ERA!
Come back! For 'Tomorrow's Breakfast!' Presumptuous! But FUN!
purchase_fail: Insufficient FUNDS! My boilers need COAL! Not PROMISES!
No CREDIT! Time-travel ate my PROFITS! Paradox EXPENSES!
Return with COIN! Temporal or OTHERWISE!
rumor: The conductor? Tempus? Good CUSTOMER! Punctual! Literally!
Yesterday? The time agent? Eats here! Orders the SAME thing! Every TIME!
The black hunter? Too INTENSE! Food goes COLD! Just his PRESENCE!
Brutalia? In Obsidian? My RIVAL! Steam-powered TOO! Copycat!
The barrel? Temporal ENERGY? Could POWER my ovens! INFINITE cooking!
dialog.quest_hook: Ingredient CRISIS! 'Yesterday's Lunch' needs ACTUAL yesterday! But delivery STUCK! In TIME! Fetch it?!
dialog.quest_active: Still STUCK! Somewhere between THEN and NOW! Find it!
dialog.quest_complete: RETRIEVED! The ingredients! Fresh! From YESTERDAY! Here! Temporal spice rack! For YOUR kitchen!
farewell: Time is FLAVOR! And FLAVOR is TIME!
dialog.time_noon: Midday! LUNCH RUSH! From MULTIPLE eras! Simultaneous!
dialog.time_dusk: Evening! DINNER! Formal! Or CASUAL! By ERA!
dialog.time_night: Night! Late SNACKS! From the FUTURE! Of snacking!
dialog.rival_mention: Brutalia? In Obsidian? Steam-powered COPYCAT! I was ENHANCED first!
dialog.post_quest_greeting: The ingredient HUNTER! Yesterday SAVED! Kitchen operational!

party_reactions.kade: Another steam chef! Rivalry! I love it!
party_reactions.nix7: Cybernetic enhancement: Extensive. Steam integration: Impressive. Rivalry: Juvenile.
party_reactions.twist: STEAM POWERED CHEF! That's AMAZING! FOOD from TIME!
party_reactions.korr: He sacrificed humanity for efficiency. Tragic. Effective.
party_reactions.renna: The enhancements are magically mechanical. Stable. Remarkable.
party_reactions.suresh: He found new path through transformation. The Middle Path... mechanized.
party_reactions.sova: Interesting food. Fast service. I'd eat here.
party_reactions.grit: Field rations from multiple eras. Useful. Weird.
party_reactions.ashka: He burns steam. Not fire. But still heat. Acceptable.
party_reactions.senna: He knows recipes from all time. Valuable. For... various purposes.
party_reactions.callum: His kitchen hygiene! EXCELLENT! Across ALL eras!

relationship_dialog.stranger: NEW! Try the 'Timeless Stew!' Always FRESH!
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: RETURNING! You have GOOD taste! In TIME!
relationship_dialog.friend: FAVORITE customer! I save the GOOD temporal ingredients!
relationship_dialog.best_friend: COLLEAGUE! In CUISINE! Here! My secret RECIPE book! Across ERAS!

mini_quest.title: Yesterday's Lunch
mini_quest.description: Help Piston retrieve ingredients stuck in temporal transit for his signature dish

stages.active: Check the Time-Train! Cargo car! Between platforms! Temporal LIMBO!
stages.complete: RETRIEVED! Fresh from YESTERDAY! Literally! Here! Temporal spice rack! For YOUR culinary experiments!
